credits.title: The Anta Claus of the South Pole
credits.overview: Envious of his northern counterpart, the Anta Claus of the South Pole embarks on a penguin-powered journey to uncover the secret of a flawless Christmas. Along the way, he learns that the true spirit of the holiday lies not in perfection but in the lovable community of oddballs he left behind.

credits.title: Good Luck to You All
credits.overview: A little girl plays with her toys, blissfully unaware that she may hold the future of humanity in her hands. Good Luck to You All blends innocence, hope and panic, exploring AI’s unanswered questions with whimsy and unease.

credits.title: If I Was God
credits.overview: While dissecting a frog in Biology class, a 12-year-old boy speculates about what he would do if he were God.

credits.title: Runaway
credits.overview: A train runs into a cow on the tracks; with the captain nowhere to be found, the fireman is forced to desperately improvise in order to keep the train going.

credits.title: Strange Invaders
credits.overview: Roger and Doris are a childless couple who get more than they bargained for when a strange being crashes into their home one day.

credits.title: The World's Greatest Animation
credits.overview: A whirlwind tour of first-class animated shorts, The World's Greatest Animation assembles, for the first time, an eye-popping assortment of Academy Award winners and nominees from the years 1978-90. credits.title: The Cat Came Back
credits.overview: A pesky yellow cat becomes the bane of Mr. Johnson's life as it constantly outsmarts his increasingly desperate attempts to get rid of it.

credits.title: 2 Flies
credits.overview: Two flies land on a man's nose and take a bite.
